Container.Name: forge90
Container.Overview: FORGE 90 — a self-hosted weight-lifting and meal-planning web app. A 90-day Push/Pull/Legs program that keeps going in 13-week cycles, macro-scaled meals from 36 high-protein recipes and 650+ foods, a money-saving grocery planner, weigh-in and PR tracking, and invite-only accounts with an admin console and password-reset email.
Container.Requires: Invite and password-reset emails need a Gmail App Password (Google account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords) in SMTP_PASS.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Accounts, settings and every user's plan. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The address people open FORGE 90 at (used in invite and password-reset links). Use your Unraid IP and port, or your https:// domain behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: Gmail account that sends invite and password-reset emails.

Config.Name: SMTP_PASS
Config.Description: 16-letter Gmail App Password for SMTP_USER (spaces are fine). Can also be set later in Admin → Email.

Config.Name: MAIL_FROM
Config.Description: From address on emails (normally the same as SMTP_USER).

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Default administrator, created on first start only. You choose a new password (and can change the email) at first sign-in.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: First-start password for the default administrator (must be changed at first sign-in).

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to true behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel) so HTTPS and client IPs are detected.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: auto marks the sign-in cookie Secure whenever HTTPS is used.
